pages.text: Some cards cannot be combined, or need something else first. The game explains this with tooltips.$(br2)$(thing)Exclusive$(): a card can refuse to share a farm with another card or with a tool enchantment (for example Silk Touch).

$(thing)Required$(): a card can need another card installed too, or a heat source under the farm.$(br2)When you hold a card over a slot that would refuse it, the tooltip says why. A card's own tooltip lists its rules.

Rules are checked all the time: if the recipe, the tool or the other cards change so that a rule is broken, the card stays in its slot but is switched off. Where two cards clash, the one in the earlier slot keeps working.
